title: The golden mean
idea: Virtue sits between two extremes, like courage between recklessness and cowardice. The right amount depends on the situation.
apply: Pick a trait you struggle with, name its excess and its deficiency, and aim for the middle in one real situation today.
remind: Find the middle. Not too much, not too little.
who: Sam, a new manager who swings between harsh and silent.

items.x: Wed: says nothing, hopes it improves

scenes.nar: Sam is a new manager who swings between extremes. Some days he is harsh, other days he says nothing at all.
Aristotle taught that virtue sits between two extremes. Too harsh, and people fear you. Too soft, and problems grow.
The mean is not a half-measure. It is the right amount, at the right time: honest, specific, and delivered with care.
Sam gives feedback within a day, specific and kind. His team trusts him, and surprises become rare.
